title: Fantastic service
content:
My mom has Alzheimer’s and mobility problems as I was unable to get her to the surgery so asked if they do a home visit.

They came within half hour,we are extremely fortunate to such wonderful caring GP, sevice her in Chaddesley.

As a family we are so greatful to each and everyone at the surgery.
Thank you from the bottom of our hearts
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
